# Single 〔BlitzLLVM〕

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Types](Language-Features-Types)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Single(value)
Single:Float32(value)
```

**Returns:** The Single, which is a Float.

## Description

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Converts a number or a text to a Single, another name of `Float` (a 32-bit real). `Single` is also accepted as a type in the long notation (`x:Single`) wherever `Float` is, together with `Float32`, `Real` and `Real32`, and all of them are the same type.

## Differences

* Not in the originals, which only have `Float`.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
x:Single = Single(7) / 2
Print x
Print x = Float(3.5)
```

```text
3.5
1
```
